title: cellmapper
description:
Transfer labels from a reference to a query using CellMapper in a shared
embedding space.

dataset input.title: Dataset input
dataset input.description: Dataset input using nf-tower "dataset" or "data explorer". Allows for the input of multiple parameter sets to initialise a Nextflow channel.

param_list.description: Dataset input can either be a list of maps, a csv file, a json file, a yaml file, or simply a yaml blob. The names of the input fields (e.g. csv columns, json keys) need to be an exact match with the workflow input parameters.

input.description: The query data to transfer the labels to. Should be a .h5mu file.
input.help_text: type: `string`, multiple: False, required, direction: `input`, example: `['input.h5mu']`

input_obsm_features.description:
The `.obsm` key of the embedding to use for the classifier's inference. If not provided, the `.X` slot will be used instead.
Make sure that embedding was obtained in the same way as the reference embedding (e.g. by the same model or preprocessing).

reference.description: The reference data to train classifiers on.

reference_obsm_features.description:
The `.obsm` key of the embedding to use for the classifier's training. If not provided, the `.X` slot will be used instead.
Make sure that embedding was obtained in the same way as the query embedding (e.g. by the same model or preprocessing).

reference_obs_targets.description: The `.obs` key(s) of the target labels to transfer.

output.description: The query data in .h5mu format with predicted labels transferred from the reference.

output_obs_predictions.description:
In which `.obs` slots to store the predicted information.
If provided, must have the same length as `--reference_obs_targets`.
If empty, will default to the `reference_obs_targets` combined with the `"_pred"` suffix.

output_obs_probability.description:
In which `.obs` slots to store the probability of the predictions.
If provided, must have the same length as `--reference_obs_targets`.
If empty, will default to the `reference_obs_targets` combined with the `"_probability"` suffix.

output_compression.description:
Compression format to use for the output AnnData and/or Mudata H5 files.
By default no compression is applied.

n_neighbors.description: Number of neighbors used by CellMapper.

kernel_method.description: Method to use for computing the CellMapper mapping matrix.

nextflow input-output arguments.title: Nextflow input-output arguments
nextflow input-output arguments.description: Input/output parameters for Nextflow itself. Please note that both publishDir and publish_dir are supported but at least one has to be configured.
